Step Into TheHighWRLD

A Juice WRLD community built for fans who want to connect, share, and celebrate the legacy together. This is a space where members can explore music-inspired content, discuss Juice WRLD's impact, share creative artwork concepts, and stay updated through announcements and community posts. With voice channels, chats, and interactive spaces for different topics, the server is designed to keep conversations active and meaningful while giving everyone a place to express themselves. Whether you're here to talk about music, meet other fans, or just be part of the 999 atmosphere, this community is built to bring people together. Join us and help keep the Juice WRLD legacy alive.

OFFICIAL SERVER RULES 📜

By joining or participating in TheHighWRLD, all members agree to follow these rules, Discord's Terms of Service, and Community Guidelines. These rules are designed to maintain a safe, respectful, and welcoming environment for everyone in the community.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

01 💬 Respectful Communication

Members are expected to communicate respectfully with others. Harassment, bullying, hate speech, personal attacks, intimidation, and intentionally hostile behavior are not allowed. Disagreements are allowed, but they must remain respectful and should not become personal conflicts.

02 🚫 Spam and Disruptive Behavior

Spam, excessive messages, unnecessary mentions, repeated content, message flooding, and attempts to disrupt conversations or activities are prohibited. Members should use all channels responsibly and keep discussions enjoyable for everyone.

03 🔒 Privacy and Personal Information

Members must respect the privacy of others. Sharing, requesting, or collecting personal information without permission is strictly prohibited. This includes passwords, private conversations, account information, and other confidential details.

04 🔞 Inappropriate Content

NSFW, explicit, illegal, harmful, or inappropriate content is not allowed within the server. This includes messages, images, videos, links, or any other content that violates Discord policies or community standards.

05 🎯 Harassment and Targeting

Members may not repeatedly target, threaten, intimidate, stalk, or harass another person. Encouraging others to attack, bully, or target someone is also prohibited.

06 🛑 Threats and Violent Conduct

Threats of violence, encouragement of real-world harm, or attempts to organize dangerous actions are strictly prohibited. Serious threats may result in immediate removal from the community.

07 🎭 Impersonation

Members may not impersonate staff, artists, community members, organizations, or others to deceive or mislead people. False claims of authority or identity are prohibited.

08 🕵 Doxxing and Privacy Violations

Members may not repeatedly target, intimidate, stalk, threaten, or harass another individual. Coordinated harassment, encouraging others to target an individual, or continuing unwanted contact after being asked to stop is prohibited.

09 💻 Security and Bot Abuse

Malware, viruses, phishing, scams, hacking attempts, malicious files, exploits, and attempts to compromise accounts or systems are not allowed. Abusing bots, verification systems, or server features may result in punishment.

10 💰 Fraud and Scams

Fraud, fake giveaways, deceptive offers, phishing attempts, and attempts to steal accounts, money, or information are prohibited. Members must not use the server to manipulate or financially harm others.

11 ⚖ Illegal Activities

TheHighWRLD may not be used to organize, promote, encourage, or assist illegal activities. Members are expected to follow applicable laws, Discord policies, and community standards while participating in the server.

12 🔄 Ban Evasion

Members who receive moderation actions may not use alternate accounts or other methods to avoid restrictions. Attempts to bypass bans, warnings, timeouts, or other staff actions may result in additional consequences.

13 👔 Staff Decisions

Members are expected to respect decisions made by moderators and administrators. If a member believes a decision was incorrect, they should use the proper appeal or support process instead of causing conflict.

14 📢 False Reports and Moderation Abuse

The reporting and moderation systems must be used responsibly. False, misleading, or malicious reports intended to harm another member, waste staff time, or manipulate decisions are prohibited.

15 🛡 Community Integrity

Members are expected to help create a positive, welcoming, and enjoyable environment for everyone. Actions that intentionally create conflict, damage the community, manipulate members, or disrupt server activities may result in moderation action.

16 👮 Discord Terms and Community Guidelines

All members must follow Discord's Terms of Service and Community Guidelines while using TheHighWRLD. These policies apply to all server activity, including messages, media, links, voice communication, profiles, and other interactions. Violations of Discord policies may result in moderation action within TheHighWRLD in addition to any action taken by Discord.

Discord Terms of Service: discord.com/terms
Discord Community Guidelines: discord.com/guidelines

The Vault

Curated selections from the vault

Jarad Anthony Higgins 1998 - 2019

Known as Juice WRLD — American rapper, singer, and songwriter. A leading figure in SoundCloud rap, known for emotionally raw lyrics, melodic flows, genre-blending sound, and legendary freestyle ability. His music fused hip-hop, rock, pop-punk, and R&B, creating a vulnerable yet powerful style that connected with millions worldwide.

75B+ streams 5 albums #1 Billboard

Early Life & Education — Born December 2, 1998 in Chicago, Illinois. His father, an evangelical Christian preacher, abandoned the family when Jarad was three. His mother Carmella Wallace, a devout Christian, raised him and his older brother as a single parent in Homewood, a south suburb of Chicago. He attended Homewood-Flossmoor High School, playing football and running track, graduating in 2017. Influenced by classic rock (Pink Floyd, Billy Idol, Blink-182), alternative (Fall Out Boy, Panic! at the Disco), and hip-hop (Travis Scott, Chief Keef, Kid Cudi). Began drinking lean and using pills in his early teens.

Musical Beginnings — Taught himself piano at age 4, then guitar and drums by ear. Began freestyling in high school, uploading to SoundCloud in 2015 under the name JuicetheKidd. Adopted the name Juice WRLD — inspired by the film Juice (Tupac Shakur) and "world" — representing his ambition to take over the world. Early sound blended UK drill, Chicago drill, and melodic rap. First track "Too Much Cash" recorded at age 17. Gained local buzz through freestyles over beats from his favorite artists. His early SoundCloud catalog included dozens of tracks that remain fan favorites.

Breakthrough — "Lucid Dreams" (2018) went viral on SoundCloud within weeks, peaking at #2 on Billboard Hot 100, becoming diamond-certified with 2B+ Spotify streams. The single "All Girls Are the Same" caught the attention of Grade A Productions' Lil Bibby, leading to a joint venture with Interscope Records. Both tracks anchored his debut album. The Sting-sampled guitar riff on "Lucid Dreams" became one of the most recognizable melodies of the decade. He performed both songs at his first major festival, Rolling Loud, in 2018.

Discography — Goodbye & Good Riddance (2018, 3x Platinum) introduced his signature heartbreak-rap sound with hits like "Lucid Dreams" and "All Girls Are the Same". Death Race for Love (2019, #1 debut) showcased genre versatility with "Robbery", "Hear Me Calling", and "Empty". Legends Never Die (2020, posthumous #1, biggest streaming week of 2020) featured "Come & Go" with Marshmello and "Wishing Well". Fighting Demons (2021, #2) accompanied the documentary Into the Abyss. The Party Never Ends (2024) served as his final posthumous release. EPs include WRLD Domination (2018), Too Soon.. (2018), Binge Drinking (2024), and collaborative mixtape What Is This? with Ski Mask the Slump God.

Songwriting & Studio Process — Known for his extraordinary freestyle ability. Most of his songs were recorded in a single take with no written lyrics — he would hear a beat and improvise the entire track on the spot. His engineer Max Lord described him as a "musical savant" who could recall hundreds of freestyles from memory. Often recorded 3-4 complete songs per session, sometimes making 50+ songs in a single month. His vault contains over 2,000 unreleased tracks spanning every era of his career.

Style & Influence — Pioneered the "sadboy" aesthetic defining late-2010s hip-hop. His genre-blending sound fused hip-hop, rock, pop-punk, and R&B, opening the door for artists like The Kid LAROI, Iann Dior, and Lil Tracy. His unflinching vulnerability around heartbreak, addiction, and mortality resonated with millions. Credited with normalizing emotional expression in hip-hop and bridging the gap between rap and alternative music.

Collaborations — Worked with Future, Young Thug, Ellie Goulding, BTS, Trippie Redd, Marshmello, Halsey, Travis Barker, Kid Cudi, Polo G, The Kid LAROI, Lil Yachty, and Benny Blanco. His feature on "Godzilla" with Eminem hit the top 10 and set a record for fastest rap verse. Posthumous features continued with Justin Bieber on "Wandered to LA", Coldplay, and Eminem on "Lace It". He appeared on the Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse soundtrack with "Hide" (feat. Seezyn).

Record Labels & Business — Signed to Grade A Productions (founded by Lil Bibby) and Interscope Records in 2018. His deal was notable for allowing him significant creative control and ownership of his masters. Released music under his own imprint, Grade A, which became a powerhouse in modern hip-hop. His estate, managed by his mother Carmella, continues to oversee one of the most valuable catalogues in the industry — valued at over $100 million.

Tours & Performances — Headlined his first tour, the WRLD Domination Tour (2018), across North America and Europe. Performed at Rolling Loud, Lollapalooza, Bonnaroo, and Coachella (2019). His final performance took place on November 30, 2019 in Sheffield, England, just days before his death. Fans consider his live performances legendary for their raw energy and emotional intensity.

Documentary & Media — Featured in the HBO documentary Juice WRLD: Into the Abyss (2021), directed by Tommy Oliver, which chronicled his life, struggles, and the aftermath of his death. A second documentary Juice WRLD: The Party Never Ends (2024) explored his posthumous legacy and vault. His story has been covered in The New York Times, Rolling Stone, Billboard, and The Guardian.

Personal Life & Struggles — On-and-off relationship with Alexia "Ally" Lotti (2015–2019), who was with him on his final flight. Open about his use of lean, Percocet, and Xanax — often referencing them in lyrics while painfully acknowledging the irony of romanticizing substance abuse. Suffered from anxiety, depression, and chronic insomnia. Made genuine efforts to get clean in mid-2019, cutting back on lean and seeking professional help. His music served as his primary outlet, often documenting his internal battles in real time.

Philanthropy & Impact — His mother Carmella Wallace founded the Live Free 999 Fund in 2020 to support youth mental health, addiction recovery, and substance abuse education. The fund has raised millions and partnered with organizations nationwide. Juice's legacy also includes posthumous scholarships at his former high school and donations to music education programs in Chicago.

Death — Passed on December 8, 2019 at Midway International Airport, Chicago, hours after arriving from California on a private flight. FBI and Chicago Police investigated due to the presence of armed security and large quantities of luggage. Suffered a seizure in the airport terminal; cause determined to be oxycodone and codeine overdose. He was 21 years old. Tributes poured in from Drake, Post Malone, Kendrick Lamar, Travis Scott, Halsey, Ellen DeGeneres, and President Barack Obama. Interred at Beverly Cemetery, Blue Island, Illinois. December 8 is observed by fans worldwide as Juice WRLD Day.

Awards & Records — Billboard Music Award: Top Male Artist, Top New Artist, Top Streaming Songs Artist (2020). Record for most simultaneous Billboard Hot 100 entries by a single artist (13 in 2020). Multiple BET Hip Hop Awards. Chicago Walk of Fame star (2021). Over 75 billion global streams. "Lucid Dreams" named one of Rolling Stone's 500 Greatest Songs. His music continues to chart years after his passing — a testament to his enduring connection with fans.

999 Meaning — Represents taking negativity and turning it into positivity — the inversion of "666." Adopted as his core philosophy and brand symbol. "999 represents taking whatever bad situation you're going through and using it to push yourself forward." The symbol appears on his album art, merchandise, and is tattooed on his arm. It became a rallying cry for his fanbase worldwide, representing resilience, hope, and the eternal spirit of the WRLD.

Cultural Impact — Over 75 billion global streams, ranking among the top 10 most-streamed artists of all time. His music garners over 30 million monthly listeners on Spotify. "Lucid Dreams" alone has been used in over 10 million TikTok videos. His influence extends beyond music into fashion, with his signature style (braids, chains, colorful designer pieces) inspiring a generation of youth. Annual Juice WRLD Day celebrations feature charity events, concerts, and fan gatherings in Chicago and worldwide.

"Service": TheHighWRLD website, including all pages, features, and functionality accessible through the site.
"Data Controller": The entity that determines the purposes and means of processing personal data. For the purposes of this Privacy Policy, TheHighWRLD is the data controller.
"Data Processor": The entity that processes personal data on behalf of the data controller.
"Session Storage": A browser-based storage mechanism that persists only for the duration of a browser tab or window session.
"Local Storage": A browser-based storage mechanism that persists beyond browser Sessions until explicitly cleared by the user.
"Cookies": Small text files placed on your device by websites you visit, used for tracking, authentication, preferences, and analytics.

2. Information We Do NOT Collect

We do not collect, store, or transmit any personal information. This site runs entirely on your local machine when accessed via the file:// protocol. Specifically, we do NOT use:

• Cookies of any kind (persistent or session-based, first-party or third-party).
• Tracking scripts or analytics services (Google Analytics, Meta Pixel, Cloudflare Analytics, Heap, Mixpanel, etc.).
• Browser fingerprinting, canvas fingerprinting, or device identification techniques.
• Web beacons, pixel tags, clear GIFs, embedded trackers, or tracking URLs.
• Sign-up forms, registration syStems, login syStems, or user accounts.
• Email collection, newsletter subscriptions, or mailing lists.
• Ad networks, affiliate tracking, or referral tracking.
• Server logs, access logs, or error logs that capture IP addresses or user agent strings.
• Social media widgets, share buttons, or embedded social plugins that transmit data to third parties.
• Any form of behavioral advertising, remarketing, or targeted advertising technologies.

3. Local-Only Browser Storage

Session Storage (Sessionstorage): We use Sessionstorage solely for verification state during your current browsing session. This is a temporary storage mechanism built into your browser that:

• Stores data only for the duration of your current tab or window session.
• Is automatically and irrevocably cleared when you close your browser tab or window.
• Is never transmitted to any server, third party, or external service.
• Is not used for tracking, profiling, identification, or analytics purposes.
• Contains no personal identifiers, unique identifiers, or contact information.

Local Storage (localStorage): We use localStorage solely for storing your preferences, favorites, and listening history locally on your device. This data:

• Persists only on your local machine until you clear it via browser settings or the Service's "Clear History" feature.
• Is never transmitted to any server, third party, or external service.
• Is not accessible to us or any third party under any circumstances.
• Contains only non-personal preference data (track identifiers, timestamps, UI state).

No persistent IndexedDB, WebSQL, Cache API, cookies, or any other form of browser storage is used by this Service for any purpose. We do not read, write, or access any browser storage mechanisms beyond those explicitly described above.

4. Audio Files and Media Assets

All audio files, cover art, images, and other media assets are loaded directly from your local disk when the site is opened via the file:// protocol. No media is streamed from, uploaded to, transmitted to, or processed by any external server. The Service is designed to function fully offline without sending or receiving data over a network. Your listening activity, playback history, and media interactions are entirely private and known only to you. We have no technical means to access, monitor, or record your listening behavior.

5. Data Security Measures

Since we collect no personal data, the risk of a data breach affecting user information on our end is effectively eliminated. However, we implement the following security measures to protect the integrity and availability of the Service:

• The Service is designed to operate without any server-side data storage, eliminating server-side data breach risks.
• No authentication syStems, user databases, or credential storage exists, eliminating credential theft risks.
• No network requests for data transmission are made by the Service, eliminating network-based data interception risks.
• If the Service is accessed over a network (e.g., via a local web server or future hosted version), we will implement industry-standard encryption (TLS 1.3) to protect data in transit.
• We follow security best practices for all code and dependencies used by the Service, including regular dependency audits and updates.

However, you should be aware that: (a) any information you choose to share on linked third-party platforms (such as Discord) is governed by their security practices, not ours; (b) no data transmission over the internet is completely secure, but our Service minimizes this risk by operating primarily offline and without data collection; and (c) you are responsible for maintaining the security of your local device and browser environment.

6. Data Retention and Deletion

Since we collect no personal data, we retain no personal data. The only data that exists in connection with your use of the Service is described in Section 5 above. Specifically:

• Session Storage: Automatically deleted when you close your browser tab or window. No action is required on your part.
• Local Storage (Favorites, History, Preferences): Persists on your local device until you: (a) clear your browser's localStorage via developer tools or privacy settings; (b) use the "Clear History" feature within the Service; (c) clear your browser's site data; or (d) use private/incognito browsing mode, in which case localStorage is automatically cleared when you close the private browsing window.

We have no ability to access, retrieve, read, modify, restore, or delete any data stored in your browser. All such data is under your exclusive control. We do not set any automated deletion schedules, retention policies, or expiration periods for locally stored data, as we have no mechanism to do so.

7. User Control, Transparency, and Your Choices

You retain full and exclusive control over any data stored locally by the Service. You have the following options to manage, control, and delete your data:

• Clear session storage by simply closing your browser tab or window.
• Clear localStorage, including favorites and listening history, through your browser's developer tools, privacy settings, or site settings panel.
• Use the "Clear History" feature within the Service to reset listening data without affecting other localStorage items.
• Configure your browser to block localStorage or Sessionstorage entirely (though this may affect certain features of the Service, such as favorites persistence).
• Use private, incognito, or guest browsing mode, which automatically prevents localStorage from persisting beyond your session.
• Use your browser's "Clear Site Data" or "Clear Storage" functionality for this specific site.
• Utilize browser extensions or built-in tools that manage local storage on your behalf.

We encourage you to familiarize yourself with your browser's privacy and storage settings. Common resources include: Chrome Privacy and Security Settings, Firefox Privacy and Security Preferences, Safari Privacy Preferences, Edge Privacy Settings. We have no ability to access, read, modify, or delete data stored in your browser, and any such data can be removed by you at any time using the methods described above. We do not track, log, or maintain records of any user choices, preferences, or configurations.

8. Contact Information and Data Protection Inquiries

If you have any questions, concerns, comments, or requests regarding this Privacy Policy, our data practices, or your privacy rights, please do not hesitate to contact us:

Primary Contact Channel: Our Discord server (invite link available on the Service).
Response Time: We aim to acknowledge receipt of inquiries within five (5) business days and to provide a substantive response within ten (10) to fifteen (15) business days, depending on complexity.
Data Protection Officer: For matters requiring escalation, please request to speak with our designated Data Protection Officer through the Discord server.

When contacting us about privacy matters, please include: (a) your name and the jurisdiction you are writing from; (b) a clear description of your question, concern, or request; (c) any relevant details about your use of the Service; and (d) your preferred method of response. We are committed to addressing all privacy-related inquiries promptly, respectfully, and transparently. We value your privacy and your trust.

DMCA Takedown Policy

Last updated: August 2026

TheHighWRLD ("we," "us," or "our") respects the intellectual property rights of others and expects the same from our users. This policy explains how copyright owners and their authorized representatives can report alleged copyright infringement occurring on or through the Service, and how we handle those reports in accordance with the Digital Millennium Copyright Act (DMCA), 17 U.S.C. § 512.

1. What This Policy Covers

This policy applies to all content hosted, displayed, streamed, or otherwise made available through the Service, including audio files, lyrics, artwork, images, text, and metadata. We take claims of copyright infringement seriously and will act expeditiously to remove or disable access to material identified in a valid takedown notice.

2. How to Submit a DMCA Takedown Notice

If you are the copyright owner of a work, or are authorized to act on behalf of one, and you believe that material on the Service infringes your copyright, you may submit a written takedown notice. To be effective, your notice must include each of the elements required by the DMCA (see Section 3 below).

3. Required Information in Your Notice

A complete notice must contain the following:

  • Signature. Your physical or electronic signature (typing your full legal name at the end of the notice satisfies this requirement).
  • Identification of the work. Identification of the copyrighted work you claim has been infringed, or, if your notice covers multiple works, a representative list of those works.
  • Identification of the material. Identification of the material you claim is infringing, with information reasonably sufficient to allow us to locate it (for example, the track name, artist, and approximate location or URL).
  • Your contact information. Your name, mailing address, telephone number, and email address.
  • Good faith statement. A statement that you have a good faith belief that the use of the material is not authorized by the copyright owner, its agent, or the law.
  • Accuracy statement. A statement, made under penalty of perjury, that the information in your notice is accurate and that you are the copyright owner or authorized to act on behalf of the owner.

4. Where to Send Your Notice

Send your completed notice to our designated copyright contact through our Discord server (invite link available on the Service). Clearly label your message with the subject line DMCA Takedown Notice and include all of the information listed in Section 3. We acknowledge receipt of notices and will respond as required by law.

5. What Happens After We Receive a Valid Notice

Upon receiving a notice that substantially complies with the DMCA, we will:

  • Respond expeditiously to remove or disable access to the material identified in the notice;
  • Make a reasonable attempt to notify the user who posted the material that it has been removed or disabled;
  • Forward the notice to the affected user so they may respond with a counter-notice if they believe the removal was a mistake or misidentification; and
  • Take appropriate action against repeat infringers in accordance with Section 7 below.

As permitted by law, we may send you a copy of your notice, and the identity of the party who submitted it, to the affected user.

6. Counter-Notice Procedure

If you believe that material you posted to the Service was removed or disabled as a result of mistake or misidentification, you may submit a counter-notice. Your counter-notice must include:

  • Your physical or electronic signature;
  • Identification of the material that was removed or disabled and the location where it appeared before it was removed;
  • A statement, under penalty of perjury, that you have a good faith belief that the material was removed or disabled as a result of mistake or misidentification;
  • Your name, address, and telephone number; and
  • A statement that you consent to the jurisdiction of the federal district court for the judicial district in which your address is located (or, if your address is outside the United States, any judicial district in which the Service may be found), and that you will accept service of process from the person who submitted the original takedown notice.

Submit counter-notices through the same channel described in Section 4, with the subject line DMCA Counter-Notice. Unless the copyright owner files a court action seeking to keep the material down, we will restore the material within a reasonable period after receiving a valid counter-notice.

7. Repeat Infringer Policy

In appropriate circumstances, we maintain a policy of terminating the access of users who are determined to be repeat infringers of copyright. We also reserve the right to remove or disable access to material and to suspend or terminate access to the Service, in whole or in part, for any user who we believe has violated these Terms or applicable law.

8. Good Faith and Accuracy Requirements

Under Section 512(f) of the DMCA, any person who knowingly materially misrepresents that material is infringing, or that it was removed by mistake or misidentification, may be liable for damages (including costs and attorneys’ fees) incurred by the alleged infringer, by any copyright owner or its authorized licensee, or by a service provider. Please make sure your notice is accurate and complete before submitting it.

9. Changes to This Policy

We may update this DMCA policy from time to time. The most current version will always be posted on this page. Your continued use of the Service after we post changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

10. Contact

If you have questions about this policy, please contact us through our Discord server (invite link available on the Service). For formal takedown notices, follow the process in Sections 3 and 4 above.
